_about: Old product names -> the ONE product id (the catalog id). names.product_id() reads this, plus every kit's kit.json "aliases" (runs/ai-elements/<brand>/products/<id>/) and the brand's Drive index product ids. Only what those two do not already say goes here: today, the store handles of bundles whose Drive id differs.
rule: 2026-10-28: the full catalog id wins (nova-face-brush, crush-bump-eliminator, bundles as their Drive ids). Store handles are aliases; nothing already made or live is renamed. An alias names exactly one product.
